items.question: What happens if a practitioner abandons betel, circle, skull-garland, and corpse-seat while attempting to accomplish Kālī?
premises: Abandoning betel, circle, skull-garland, and corpse-seat invalidates Kālī accomplishment.
These ritual supports are required for the practice.
items.inference: Without those supports, Kālī cannot be accomplished and even immense time fails for Tāriṇī.
uncertainties: Asterisk tokens are unresolved in the source.
Exact ritual sequence is not specified.
items.plain_english: Without betel, circle, skull garland, and corpse seat, Kālī cannot be accomplished; even immense time fails for Tāriṇī.
